sections.title: About this guide
data: This guide is written from the installation's official pages and the Military OneSource installation directory. It covers what those pages say about the mission, housing, schools and medical care.
Rules and offices change. Confirm the details with your sponsor and the housing office before you move.

sections.title: Housing
data: The garrison has Army family housing, and the Army has been rebuilding and replacing older homes in recent years. New arrivals are told to contact their on-island sponsor about transportation, housing and schools before they arrive.

source.label: Army Family Housing revitalization at USAG-KA

sections.title: Schools
data: The garrison describes K-12 schools on the island. Ask your sponsor for enrollment details.
